answer: The thread report shows the merge explicitly at each mirror. Each collapsed cluster gets one spiral weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. Because of that, someone who spins up 111 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 180 times the capital for one share. A farm of 4470 identities would post 4741 proofs and burn roughly 87 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
